old_caption: The video shows a close-up view of a blue plastic ice cube tray placed on a worn wooden surface. The tray is partially filled with a white, semi-transparent substance that appears to be a mixture of ice cubes and possibly some liquid or gel-like material. The substance is unevenly distributed across the tray, with some compartments containing more of the mixture than others. The wooden surface beneath the tray has visible scratches and marks, indicating frequent use. There are no animals, characters, or significant changes in the scene throughout the video. The focus remains on the tray and its contents, with no noticeable movement or action taking place. The lighting is consistent, suggesting the video was shot under the same conditions.

caption: A blue plastic tray with internal vertical divider bars rests on a scratched wooden surface dotted with water droplets, while a white plate edge stays fixed at the bottom-left. Inside sits a white, opaque, fan-shaped mass whose surface shows faint radial lines converging on a small pale spot near its top center. The camera holds still; the tray, its bars, the wood, and the plate edge keep the same image positions. The white mass slowly grows outward, its left boundary creeping into the empty left compartment. On the opposite side its right edge advances rightward, covering the rightmost blue divider bar. The lower bulge extends slightly downward, widening the white region against the blue. The radial lines and central spot stay fixed as the outline expands, and no object enters or leaves.
